```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Tag Create</title>
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tailwindcss@2.2.19/dist/tailwind.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.x.x/dist/cdn.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 font-sans text-black">
    <div class="max-w-md mx-auto p-6 rounded-lg shadow-lg bg-white">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Create Tag</h2>

        <!-- Tag Input -->
        <input wire:model="tag.name" type="text" placeholder="Enter tag name" class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none">
        
        <!-- Submit Button -->
        <button wire:click="createTag" class="bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:bg-blue-600">Create Tag</button>
    </div>

    @livewire('tag.create-component')
</body>
</html>
```

### Explanation:
1. **HTML Structure**:
   - A `div` with Tailwind classes to center the form and provide a rounded border.
   - A heading for the form title.
   - An input field using `wire:model="tag.name"` to bind the tag name.
   - A submit button using `wire:click="createTag"` to trigger the creation of the tag.

2. **Tailwind CSS**:
   - Tailwind's base styles and utilities are applied to create a simple, professional look for the form.

3. **Alpine.js**:
   - Alpine.js is used to handle dynamic behavior in the form.
   - `wire:model` binds the input field value to the `tag.name` property on the Livewire component.
   - `wire:click` triggers the `createTag` method of the Livewire component when clicked.

4. **Livewire Component**:
   - The `livewire('tag.create-component')` directive ensures that the `TagCreateComponent` component is rendered within this blade view.

This Blade view provides a clean, functional form for creating tags using Livewire and Tailwind CSS.
